passive.name: Whisper
passive.description: Jhin's hand cannon, Whisper, is a precise instrument designed to deal superior damage. It fires at a fixed rate and carries only four shots. Jhin imbues the final bullet with dark magics to critically strike and deal bonus execute damage. Whenever Whisper crits, it inspires Jhin with a burst of Move Speed.
passive.coverageNote: Ammunition and the fourth shot create a persistent ordered attack cycle. The source is assigned to the attack-cycle family, but a complete reviewed binding has not been compiled yet.

spells.name: Dancing Grenade
spells.description: Jhin launches a cartridge that deals physical damage before bouncing to a nearby enemy that has not been hit yet. The cartridge can hit a maximum of times. Enemies that die shortly after being hit increase the damage of subsequent hits by %.
